guide.office: OSCA (senior citizens), PDAO (PWDs), or CSWDO (assistance and referrals)
guide.location: Tagaytay City Hall, Akle St., Kaybagal South
guide.hours: Confirm current receiving hours with the office.
guide.fees: Confirm charges for the specific service; the 2025 Charter lists no fee for the ID steps.
guide.processingTime: Varies by service and assessment. Ask the receiving office for a release date.
checklist: Identify the office and exact ID or assistance service needed
Ask for the current requirements for your situation
Prepare identity and residency records requested by the office
Confirm whether a representative may file and what authority is needed
